name: context-shunt
description: Route large, explicit source reads to a bounded Cloudflare Worker summary.

interface.shortDescription: Summarize large, explicit source reads outside the main context.
interface.longDescription: Uses a project-local CLI and Cloudflare Worker to return a bounded, structured source summary.
defaultPrompt: Use Context Shunt to investigate these large source files.
Explain when Context Shunt is appropriate for this repository.
